dsDescriptionValue.value: The BioImage Archive stores and distributes life sciences imaging datasets. It supports deposition of biological imaging data associated with publications for the whole research community, as well as reference imaging datasets. All data deposited to the BioImage Archive is made openly accessible to the scientific community.
